PFMS Checker Pages: Before and After

Before is the Maker branch (unchanged Checker pages); after is feat/e-anudaan-pfms-checker. Same demo Checker, same seed data, 1440 wide. Captured 4 Oct 2026.

Authorisation Queue

Before: Two tabs, a Status column that repeats “Awaiting Authorisation” on every row, NGO Directory and Payment Reports in the menu. After: One list of what is waiting for your signature; Submitted column says when and by whom; menu is Dashboard, Authorisation Queue, Sanctioned Applications.

Authorise Payment Advice

Before: Breadcrumb; three columns (sanction order, a long payload, the panel); a confirmation dialog after Approve. After: Back link; status beside the name; six-row check against the sanction order; a summary with the full advice one click away; the original sanction order; the signature shown in the panel.
